label: God in the hiddenness challenge: God denotes a personal religious ultimate whose personal…
definition: God denotes a personal religious ultimate whose personal perfection is the target of this argument. Sig.God w says such a being exists at w; it does not define God as nonexistent whenever a particular human lacks belief. God-to-perfect-love is a separate open premise. This is not the broader possibility of a nonpersonal religious ultimate, nor an automatic identification of the root signature with this interpretation.
note: Explicit interpretation vocabulary for #252. Source claims retain their own pinned locators; these records do not add axioms or establish the truth of the interpreted predicates.

formal_gap.meaning: Sig.God w says that a personal religious ultimate, whose personal perfection is the argument's target, exists at world w. It is a predicate on the worlds of the hiddenness signature (#252), supplied by each interpretation. It does not define God as nonexistent whenever some person lacks belief.
formal_gap.examples_unavailable: Whether such a being exists at the actual world is the conclusion the hiddenness argument disputes; an example would presuppose an answer.
exclusions: The case root's Signature.IsGod (DEF-GOD-OF-CLASSICAL-THEISM): the two are not identified automatically.
open_obligations: GodLoves (God at w implies perfect love at w) is a separate open premise.
Any bridge from this predicate to the root signature's IsGod is open and unrecorded.
